summary: Expose exact DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and block the transitional deepseek-v4-pro alias while it routes to Flash, preventing a false same-input Pro comparison.
decision_refs: The user requested a V4.1 Flash reference followed by a Pro comparison on the same CIRP evidence scope
DeepSeek's official announcement says deepseek-v4-pro routes to V4.1 Flash until V4.1 Pro launches
Historical aliases and evaluation identities must remain readable and immutable
approval_evidence: The user explicitly authorized DeepSeek API use for a Flash reference and subsequent Pro comparison.
known_limitations: DeepSeek has not published an independent V4.1 Pro model ID, so an honest Pro comparison cannot run yet.
The transitional deepseek-v4-pro alias is rejected before dispatch because it currently routes to Flash.
Configuration acceptance tests are offline; the separately authorized V4.1 Flash baseline is operational evidence, not an acceptance-test side effect.
Model selection does not establish answer correctness or model superiority.
